subject: BlueHelix security portal onboarding preflight: Vendr & SIG mapping
messages:
From: Sara Barnes <sara.barnes@bluehelix.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-29T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: BlueHelix security portal onboarding: Vendr & SIG preflight

Hi Kimberly,

Quick introduction — I run security operations at BlueHelix Finance. We're getting ready to onboard Redwood into our vendor security portals (Vendr preferred; we also support OneTrust). Before we accept an invite we wanted to run a short preflight so our internal procurement and legal teams understand the scope.

High-level asks:
- Do you have a standard preboarding checklist for Vendr/Whistic?
- Which artifacts do you expect up front (SOC 2 attestation, CAIQ mapping, SIG)?
- For evidence uploads, can you support S3 presigned uploads or do you require API-only ingestion?
- Are you able to provide a short mapping from Redwood's SOC 2 scope to the CAIQ questionnaire (a template would be great)?

We'd like to target a 2-week window for initial evidence collection but procurement wants to confirm technical details first. Copied Tom (legal) on this thread.

Thanks — can you share the checklist and any timeline expectations?

Sara Barnes
Security Operations
BlueHelix Finance
From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: Sara Barnes <sara.barnes@bluehelix.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-29T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: BlueHelix security portal onboarding: Vendr & SIG preflight

Hi Sara — great to meet you, and thanks for outlining the ask. I'm Kimberly (Security Programs) — happy to run the onboarding and keep legal/procurement moving. Below is a concise preboarding plan and what we'll attach to the portal.

Preboarding steps (high level):
1) Portal invite: we'll ask you to add a Redwood service account to Vendr (email: vendors@redwood.com) so we can push the CAIQ/SIG mapping and upload artifacts. If you prefer we can accept a user invite for one of our stewards.
2) Evidence: please expect the following artifacts from our side — SOC 2 Type II report (redacted), SOC 2 bridge letter (if applicable), CAIQ mapping (we'll provide a prefilled template), SIG mapping notes, and sample syslog/KMS proof snippets for ownership.
3) Upload mechanics: Vendr works with S3 presigned and API ingest; our preference is presigned S3 for large attachments, API for QnA fields. We'll attach presign instructions.
4) SSO and access: we support SAML 2.0; for portal uploads a short-lived service account + delegated SSO token works best.
5) Timeline: if you can invite us today we can populate the CAIQ and SIG mapping within 4 business days and push artifacts within 7 business days, assuming SOC2 is available.

Attachments: I attached our Redwood_Vendr_Onboarding_Checklist.pdf and Redwood_CAIQ_Mapping_Template.xlsx to speed things up.

Proposed next step: 30-minute kickoff to confirm SSO metadata and the presign bucket. Are you available today 3–4pm PT or tomorrow morning?

Best,

Kimberly Park
Senior Security Programs Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Sara Barnes <sara.barnes@bluehelix.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: Tom Wu <tom.wu@bluehelix.com>
Date: 2027-05-29T11:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: BlueHelix security portal onboarding: Vendr & SIG preflight

Thanks Kimberly — that plan looks good. A few clarifications from our side:
- Procurement prefers to receive SOC 2 redacted PDF via secure upload rather than email; we'll enable a presign window on our side.
- Legal (cc'd Tom) will confirm what redactions are acceptable — Tom, can you confirm a timeline?
- For the SSO/service account: we typically create a dedicated portal user (portal-upload@bluehelix.com) and whitelist Redwood's service account. Will that work?
- We also have an internal CAIQ reviewer who prefers a mapping file with column-level comments; the template you sent should be fine but can you add an example row mapping (control to SOC-2 section) for clarity?

Tom: can you confirm SOC2 acceptance criteria and whether we need an NDA update before sharing redacted reports?

Sara
From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: Sara Barnes <sara.barnes@bluehelix.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-29T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: BlueHelix security portal onboarding: Vendr & SIG preflight

Sara — thanks, and appreciated for looping in Tom. Quick answers and next steps:

- SOC 2: presigned upload is perfect. Once Tom confirms redaction rules we'll upload the redacted PDF to the presign bucket. We'll also include a one-page attestation summary (controls in-scope and hosting regions).

- Service account / portal user: creating portal-upload@bluehelix.com and whitelisting vendors@redwood.com is ideal. We'll provide the SAML metadata if you want to do a short SSO test before we upload large files.

- CAIQ template: I've added an example row in the attached Redwood_CAIQ_Mapping_Template.xlsx (control mapping -> SOC 2 section + short rationale). If you prefer I'll inline 3 example mappings in the portal QnA.

- Presign instructions: attaching a short presign-instructions.txt with the exact header and content expectations (key format, TTL, encryption tag). Please confirm the S3 bucket name you plan to use and whether we should rotate keys after upload window closes.

Action items:
- Tom (legal): confirm redaction acceptance and whether we need any amendment to the current NDA by EOD 5/31.
- Sara: invite vendors@redwood.com to your Vendr account or send portal invite to kimberly_park@redwood.com.
- Marissa/Jonas (cc): we'll run the CAIQ mapping and push the first pass once the invite is visible.

Looking forward — I'll schedule a short 30m call for tomorrow and include presign details.
